name: Outsource App Development to India
promise: iOS, Android and web apps from discovery to App Store, built in your accounts.
intro: gaa-tha is an India-based app development team for US and UK startups, businesses and agencies. We design and build iOS and Android apps with Flutter or React Native, web apps and SaaS MVPs — from discovery and UX to App Store and Google Play release — with code in your repository, store accounts in your name and US business hours.

glance.bestFor: Founders, product teams and agencies that need app development capacity
glance.timeline: Discovery in two to three weeks; MVPs typically in roughly three to six months
glance.model: Fixed-scope phases or a dedicated team after a paid discovery
glance.channels: Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Firebase, Node.js

whatIs: Outsourcing app development to India means hiring an India-based team to design, build and release your mobile or web app while you keep the product decisions, the accounts and the intellectual property. The work that matters most is discovery and specification, because unclear scope is where most outsourced app projects go wrong.

gaa-tha starts every app with a paid discovery phase: user flows, a clickable prototype, a feature list ranked by priority and a release plan. We then build in sprints with demos in US business hours, keep code in your GitHub and publish under your App Store and Google Play developer accounts.
included: Paid discovery: user flows, feature list, technical plan and estimate
UX and UI design with a clickable Figma prototype
Cross-platform apps in Flutter or React Native, native where needed
Backend and APIs with Node.js or Firebase
Payments, login, push notifications, analytics and integrations
QA on real devices and TestFlight or Play Console beta testing
App Store and Google Play submission under your accounts
Post-launch support, crash monitoring and a roadmap for version two

steps.text: Flows, prototype, prioritized feature list, architecture and a phased estimate.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: UI design and a clickable prototype tested with real users where possible.

deliverables: iOS and Android builds published under your accounts
Source code in your GitHub with setup documentation
pricing: Custom-quoted after a paid discovery phase, as fixed-scope phases or a dedicated monthly team. International invoices, paid by bank wire (SWIFT), PayPal or card through Stripe.

faq.q: How do I outsource app development to India without losing control?
faq.a: Keep the developer accounts, repositories and cloud accounts in your name, agree a written scope from a discovery phase, and review working builds every sprint. gaa-tha works this way by default and signs an NDA before the brief.

Both build iOS and Android from one codebase. We recommend one in discovery based on your UI, integrations and the team who will maintain it; native Swift or Kotlin is used when an app needs deep device features.

faq.q: Who owns the app and the code?
faq.a: You do. Apps are published under your App Store and Google Play accounts and the code lives in your GitHub.

faq.q: Can you build a SaaS MVP?
faq.a: Yes. We build web-based SaaS MVPs with authentication, billing, roles and an admin panel, and plan a path from MVP to a maintainable product.

faq.q: How do you handle time zones?
faq.a: Our team works US business hours, so sprint reviews, stand-ups and urgent fixes happen during your day.

faq.q: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faq.a: Yes. Agencies can resell our app development under their brand with an NDA, non-solicitation of their clients and unbranded documentation.
